comment: v1 minimal product->entrypoint relation table (design D2 rule 2). 'plugins' holds WordPress plugin slugs; each maps to the /wp-content/plugins/<slug>/ entrypoint. 'entries' holds explicit vendor:product CPE tokens for the highest-frequency server products. Every candidate literal produced from this table is a HINT — a human curator approves each rule (design D2/§7); the table's smallness is deliberate because the corpus gate, not the table, binds candidate quality.
